title: WATCH LIVE: Trump's pick for surgeon general appears for confirmation hearing
text:
Nicole Saphier, President Donald Trump’s nominee for surgeon general, is testifying before the Senate Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee in her confirmation hearing.

The hearing is scheduled to begin at 10 a.m.
